description.text:
闪光之刃是一把复原的先驱精灵咒刃，在龙醒时中由埃勒卡斯特·巨龙克星用来杀死赤铜龙阿洛斯。此刀以尖锐而闻名，但最著名的是，它闪耀着可以致盲靠近者的光芒——这自古以来一直被用于确定刀锋边区国王的价值。

在面具十年中，人们发现闪光之刃不是普通的剑，正是卡林达尔，一柄以神话中精灵铁匠卡林达尔命名并锻造的先驱咒刃。
description.text_en:
The Gleaming Blade was a greatsword used during the Dragonwake by Elecast Dragonsbane to slay the dragon Alos the Copper. While the blade is known for its sharp vorpal quality, it is most famous for the fact that, once drawn, it shines a light that is capable of blinding those who stare too close - this blinding nature of the blade has been used since time immemorial to determine the worthiness of the Blademarcher kings.

During the Decade of Masks it was discovered that the Gleaming Blade was none other than Calindal, a precursor spellblade named after and forged by the mythological elf-smith Calindal.

description.text: 护刃修会是一支负责守护闪光之刃卡林达尔的修会，确保只有配得上它的人，才能挥舞这把剑并统治刀锋边区。大多数护刃者是由修会接纳的志愿者，有些是因其遭遇不幸而来到这里、有些则只是想为更崇高的使命而战。此外，有少数护刃者被称为目盲大师，他们都是没能通过辉光之刃考验的人。
description.text_en: The Order of the Bladestewards was a monastic order dedicated to protecting (Calindal, the Gleaming Blade) and ensuring that only the worthy may wield it and rule the Blademarches. Most members of the Blade Stewards are volunteers taken in by the Order, whether it be of unfortunate circumstance or simply a warrior looking for a higher cause. However, a small number of the Blade Stewards are known as Blind Masters, who are comprised of individuals who fail the test of the Gleaming Blade.

description.text: 埃勒卡斯特·巨龙克星，王国的创始人，是历史上第一个有记载的屠龙者。我们的缔造者的声誉是无与伦比的，许多人因此而尊敬我们的历史和国家。
description.text_en: Elecast Dragonsbane, the founder of the kingdom, is the first ever-recorded dragonslayer in history. Our founder's renown is unmatched, and many respect our history and nation for it.

description.text: 通过将我们的宗教与君主的加冕相结合，我们可以加强我们的人民对信仰和君主的忠诚。
description.text_en: By integrating our religion with the coronation of the monarch, we can strengthen both the devotion of our people to the faith and to the monarch.

effects.display: 年度科琳典范值衰减：原始值 0.1（单位待核实）

description.text: 卡林达尔就是刀锋边区，刀锋边区就是卡林达尔。任何挥舞着这把闪光之刃的人都是天生的统治者，没有他们，我们什么都不是。
description.text_en: Calindal is Blademarch and Blademarch is Calindal. Any who wield the Gleaming Blade is a worthy ruler by default, and without them: we are nothing.

description.text:
伍利领主在第五次黑火药战争中所作的一首著名的诗，详细描述了刀锋边区的骑士对机械化军团的最后一次冲锋:

「最后一位闪光骠骑兵疾驰而来，
英雄之心熊熊燃烧，闪光之刃急不可待，
他奋勇冲向机械死神：枪炮，
迎来火药的结局，尸骨无存分毫。」

——伍利领主(1853)
description.text_en:
A famous poem by Lord Wooley during the Fifth Blackpowder War, which details the last charge of the Blademarcher cavalry against a legion of mechanical soldiers:

\"the last of the bright hussars came,
with burning hearts and gleaming blade,
onwards to mechanim death: fusillade,
come powder's end: none remained.\"

-Lord Wooley (1853)

name.text_en: Bright Hussars and Their Blinding Charge

description.text: 《战争与和平贤能法案》颁布于1670年，当时正值巫师王时代，它对军队和政府进行了整体改革，以贤能授予官职，而不是封建地位、性别或影响力。
description.text_en: The Meritocracy at War and Peace Act was enacted in 1670 during the Witch-Kings Era which reformed the army and government as a whole, replacing all official positions to those of merit not feudal standing, gender or influence.

player_overview.avoid_if: 想走非军事路线或不愿处理继承试炼的玩家。
player_overview.how_it_plays: 先形成B33并稳住继承，再培养高质量陆军、修复边防，逐步向区域霸权推进。
player_overview.overview: 刀锋边区是格林潮中灭亡的东坎诺骑士王国，1444年须由合格前身重建。形成后，君主与继承人要接受闪耀之刃卡林达尔的持剑试炼；你再用剑术学校、边防要塞和精锐军队向南方与深林推进。任务末端可改名刀锋帝国，但仍是同一个国家和任务树。
player_overview.recommended_for: 喜欢骑士复国、精锐陆军和统治者培养的玩家。
signature_features: 持剑试炼将王位继承变成国家核心机制。
专属军事改革、剑术学校和边防设施。
25项任务从复国推进到同Tag刀锋帝国。
player_overview.tagline: 让下一位国王先证明自己配得上那把剑。

positive_indicators: 建立军官学校和防御设施
values.rationale: 旧边防和公共军事设施有保护作用，但王权与国家资源高度围绕军队、持剑资格和长期战役组织。普通战争及君主制不自动扣分；深林和被征服地区居民待遇未全核实。
red_flags: 政治资格与军事实力高度绑定
长期扩张可能挤压其他公共目标
